title: Gulab Sarbat
description: Gulab Sarbat (Rose Syrup) is a universally popular sweet syrup made from the pure distillate of fresh pink rose petals. This classical formulation balances excessive Pitta (heat). Reduces acidity. Acts as a mild cardiac tonic. Naturally uplifts mood.
dosage: 20–40 ml mixed with chilled milk, water, or used as a topping on traditional desserts
